{{MissingInfo|1|java}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Fire| type2=Psychic| trainername=Aria| pokemonname=Delphox| jtrainername=エル| jpokemonname=マフォクシー| tmtrainername=Elle| tmpokemonname=Mahoxy| image=[[File:Aria Delphox.png|250px]] | caption=Aria's Delphox| location=[[Kalos]]| evolution=2| gender=FemaleConfirmed in ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]''.| prevonum=653| evo1num=654| epnum=XY021| epname=A Pokévision of Things to Come!| numeps1=at most 19| evo2num=655| epnum2=XY064| epname2=Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!| numeps2=between 7 and 24| firstevoep=XY040| firstevonametiming=Prior to| firstevoname=Day Three Blockbusters! | secondevoep=XY064| secondevonametiming=Prior to| secondevoname=Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile! | firststagename=Fennekin| secondstagename=Braixen| current=[[Party|With Aria]] | java1=N/A| enva2=[[Eileen Stevens]]| java2=Unknown| enva3=[[Eileen Stevens]]| java3=[[Yuka Terasaki]]| }} '''Aria's Delphox''' (Japanese: '''エルのマフォクシー''' ''Elle's Mahoxy'') is {{an|Aria}}'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==History== [[File:Aria Delphox Stage Clothing.png|thumb|left|200px|Delphox in the Master Class]] Aria has owned Delphox since she was still a [[Pokémon Performer]]-in-training. She debuted as a Fennekin in ''[[XY021|A Pokévision of Things to Come!]]'', where she starred alongside Aria in her [[Pokévision]] video. [[Serena's Fennekin]] became jealous of her when she noticed [[Clemont's Chespin]] staring at her affectionately. In ''[[XY040|Day Three Blockbusters!]]'', she was revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Braixen. In a flashback of {{an|Shauna}}'s, Aria and Braixen were shown to have participated in many [[Pokémon Showcase]]s together. Eventually, she and her Trainer managed to enter the Master Class tournament and win. The victory gave Aria the title of {{DL|Pokémon Performer|Kalos Queen}}. Braixen physically debuted in ''[[XY047|Dreaming a Performer's Dream!]]'', where she and her Trainer gave an exhibition performance at the [[Lagoon Town]] Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class. She showed off her {{type|Fire}} [[move]]s and proceeded to toss her wand back and forth with her Trainer. She finished her performance by showing off her {{m|Fire Blast}} attack. In ''[[XY064|Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!]]'', Braixen was revealed to have evolved into a Delphox. She battled alongside Aria's {{p|Aromatisse}} against {{an|Serena}}'s Fennekin and {{TP|Serena|Pancham}} in a [[Double Battle]]. Her Trainer, using the alias '''Ariana''' (Japanese: '''エレーナ''' ''Elena''), had earlier suggested a battle with Serena to help her regain her confidence. Delphox and Aromatisse worked well together, dominating the battle field until Serena's Fennekin evolved into Braixen. However, Aria was called away and the battle ended before reaching a conclusion. In ''[[XY080|Performing with Fiery Charm!]]'', Delphox watched Serena competing in the [[Dendemille Town]] Pokémon Showcase along with her Trainer and Aromatisse. In ''[[XY090|Tag Team Battle Inspiration!]]'', Delphox was shown on television, performing alongside her Trainer and Aromatisse in a Pokémon Showcase. In ''[[XY105|Party Dancecapades!]]'', Delphox attended a dance party, hosted by [[Monsieur Pierre]], with her Trainer, where she danced with Monsieur Pierre's {{p|Klefki}}. In ''[[XY112|Master Class is in Session!]]'', Delphox watched the Pokémon Showcase Master Class in [[Gloire City]] alongside her Trainer. In the [[XY113|following episode]], she performed in the final round alongside Aromatisse and {{p|Vivillon}}, trying to defend Aria's title from Serena. Delphox combined {{m|Mystical Fire}} with Vivillon's {{m|Psybeam}} and finished the performance with Fire Blast. In the end, Aria's performance received the most votes, causing her to retain her title of Kalos Queen. ==Personality and characteristics== When shown as a Fennekin, Delphox seemed to have a lot of fun while performing. It has been stated that, in order to make an effective [[Pokévision]] video, the {{pkmn|Trainer}} and {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in question should share a [[Friendship|close bond]]. Given that Aria and Fennekin's video ranked so highly with the public vote, this can be inferred to be the case with them both. As she progressed through [[Evolution]], Delphox became more serious and elegant, conserving her energy before leaping into performances wholeheartedly.
